description: VIT Bhopal University will host Health Hackathon 3.0 on 28 and 29 January 2027. A pre-event workshop will take place on 27 January 2027. VIT Bhopal is collaborating with the Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University for this event. Its full title is “Health Hackathon 3.0: Global Health Access Innovation Challenge – Next Generation.” New Ideas for Better Healthcare The event has a clear aim: it seeks innovative ideas that can improve healthcare accessibility for more people, reduce costs, and enhance overall efficiency. Participants are invited to propose actionable solutions to real-world healthcare challenges. Key focus areas for submissions include: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery. New ways and platforms to support mental health. Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions. Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks. A Chance to Share and Build Ideas Health Hackathon 3.0 invites innovators, students, and researchers to present their concepts and refine them further. The emphasis is on practical, high-impact solutions designed to reach underserved communities and individuals facing healthcare access barriers. Event Overview & Key Dates • Pre-Event Workshop: 27 January 2027 • Main Hackathon: 28 & 29 January 2027 • Venue: VIT Bhopal University, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh • Total Prize Pool: ₹2 Lakh Registration & Submission Registration is now open. Interested teams and individuals must submit their project proposals by 31 October 2026 . To learn more, view participation guidelines, and complete registration, please visit the official Health Hackathon 3.0 event website

raw.details:
VIT Bhopal University will host Health Hackathon 3.0 on 28 and 29 January 2027. A pre-event workshop will take place on 27 January 2027.

VIT Bhopal is collaborating with the Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University for this event. Its full title is “Health Hackathon 3.0: Global Health Access Innovation Challenge – Next Generation.”

New Ideas for Better Healthcare

The event has a clear aim: it seeks innovative ideas that can improve healthcare accessibility for more people, reduce costs, and enhance overall efficiency. Participants are invited to propose actionable solutions to real-world healthcare challenges.

Key focus areas for submissions include:

  • Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery.
  • New ways and platforms to support mental health.
  • Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions.
  • Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks.

A Chance to Share and Build Ideas

Health Hackathon 3.0 invites innovators, students, and researchers to present their concepts and refine them further. The emphasis is on practical, high-impact solutions designed to reach underserved communities and individuals facing healthcare access barriers.

Event Overview & Key Dates

• Pre-Event Workshop: 27 January 2027

• Main Hackathon: 28 & 29 January 2027

• Venue: VIT Bhopal University, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh

• Total Prize Pool: ₹2 Lakh

 

 

Registration & Submission

Registration is now open. Interested teams and individuals must submit their project proposals by 31 October 2026. To learn more, view participation guidelines, and complete registration, please visit the official Health Hackathon 3.0 event website
